eligibility_criteria.income_cap: Family income up to ₹8,00,000/year [VERIFY LATEST NOTIFICATION]
eligibility_criteria.category_rules: Scheduled Caste (SC) candidate with Delhi SC Certificate.
eligibility_criteria.academic_or_work_rules: >=55% in qualifying Master's (for Ph.D.) or Bachelor's (for Master's) + unconditional accredited foreign university offer.
eligibility_criteria.exclusions: Age >=30, income >₹8L, <55% marks, or non-Delhi domicile.

benefit.summary_hi: विदेशी विश्वविद्यालय में मास्टर्स हेतु ₹10 लाख व PhD हेतु ₹20 लाख (अधिकतम ₹5 लाख/वर्ष) तक की वित्तीय सहायता।
benefit.summary_en: Up to ₹5,00,000/year (max ₹10,00,000 Master's or ₹20,00,000 Ph.D. or actual admissible expense, up to 100 selected candidates [VERIFY LATEST NOTIFICATION]).

benefit_summary.en: Up to ₹5,00,000/year (max ₹10,00,000 Master's or ₹20,00,000 Ph.D. or actual admissible expense, up to 100 selected candidates [VERIFY LATEST NOTIFICATION]).
